headline: Bulgaria's 10 % flat tax hides two cliffs and a disappearing relief: the child allowance's all-or-nothing income limits cost up to 1 180 BGN for 10 BGN of pay, and the child relief printed in the tax code (200 BGN) is a thirtieth of the real one (6 000 BGN), which has lived only in each year's late budget act since 2022.
